description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {B}.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher, adding {R}.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Slimefoot and Squee from exile to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.
